triplets.subject: Reweigh
triplets.object:
Hallucinated Object
Mentions By Up To 21
triplets.evidence_span:
On four 7B backbones, ReWEIGH reduces hallucinated object
mentions by up to 21.3% while largely preserving or improving descriptive and general
performance.

triplets.subject: Training-Free Decoding Methods
triplets.object:
Lvlm
Hallucinations Without Updating The Backbone
triplets.evidence_span:
Training-free decoding methods mitigate LVLM
hallucinations without updating the backbone.

triplets.subject: Logit Scale To The Image Median
triplets.evidence_span:
Equalizing each
position’s logit scale to the image median reduces
these ratios only to 11.0× and 4.2×, respectively,
leaving substantial dispersion in place.

triplets.subject: Reweigh
triplets.evidence_span:
Across the four
models, ReWEIGH reduces CHAIRI by 10.3%–
21.3% while largely preserving or improving F1,
so it does not simply suppress object mentions.

triplets.subject: Hair And Hallucination Rate And
triplets.object: Amber Score For All Four Backbones
triplets.evidence_span:
On AMBER generation, ReWEIGH lowers
CHAIR and hallucination rate and improves the
AMBER score for all four backbones.

triplets.subject: Opera
triplets.evidence_span:
OPERA reduces CHAIRS more strongly on Qwen, and PAI
reaches a lower CHAIRS on LLaVA-1.5, but both
give up more F1 or discriminative performance.

triplets.subject:
Our
Current Implementation
triplets.evidence_span:
Our
current implementation uses a separate calibration
table, readout layer, and intervention strength for
each backbone.
